rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Functions recursively assigning properties on objects may be the cause of accidental modification of a built-in prototype object.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Excessive Iteration
rules.description: Iterating over an object with a user-controlled .length property can cause indefinite looping.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data as arguments to some commands, such as git clone, can allow arbitrary commands to be executed.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Prepending a backslash to an ordinary character in a string does not have any effect, and may make regular expressions constructed from this string behave unexpectedly.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: When escaping special characters using a meta-character like backslash or ampersand, the meta-character has to be escaped first to avoid double-escaping, and conversely it has to be unescaped last to avoid double-unescaping.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: An attempt to use a value that is not an object or 'null' as a prototype will either be ignored or result in a runtime error.
